description: The ads this business should run, built from its own scans: three things to film, each citing a count from this agent's own leads, plus the spend and reach for a lead target. Reads only; nothing is launched and no money moves. Returns status=no_evidence when the scans have not found enough to say anything specific.

account_mode.description: Whose ad account. 'nova' needs nothing from the owner and Nova is the advertiser; 'owner' runs on their own connected account. Omit and the plan preselects by what they already have, returning both options either way.

leads_target.description: Leads a month the owner wants. Spend is derived from it.

name: admin__get_ad_plan
